Celebrini misses Sharks loss with lower-body injury

out.detail: lower-body injury, did not play in loss to Dallas Stars on Oct 6

away.summary: The Sharks lost 5-0 to the Dallas Stars on Oct 6, with star forward Macklin Celebrini sidelined by a lower-body injury. He participated in warmups but was scratched pre-game and is day-to-day. San Jose faces the Blues on Thursday seeking to rebound without their top center.

returning: : Bowen Byram will return after missing a 4-3 loss at the Buffalo Sabres on Saturday for a family matter
: Rinzel will enter the lineup after being a healthy scratch Saturday.
home.summary: The Blues split their season-opening back-to-back, beating Dallas 4-0 before losing 6-1 to Colorado. They are projected to start Joel Hofer in net against Chicago on Oct 6, with several defensive lineup experiments. Key injuries include Mailloux (hand), Tucker (knee), and Toropchenko (upper body), while Byram and Rinzel are expected to return.
